verdict.rationale: Skyvern's first-party docs say it can save signed-in state as reusable browser profiles, so you can sign in once and reuse that state later. Cookies and local storage persist across operations, and a saved login can be used by every agent. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how profiles are created and attached via API/SDK across separate runs (expiry, refresh, sharing), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can persist logged-in browser state in reusable profiles so agents skip the login wall on every subsequent run

citations.quote: save signed-in state as reusable browser profiles
Use a profile when you want to sign in once and reuse that later.
Cookies, local storage, open tabs, and the current page all persist
